card.name: Decimal point in section cross-references
card.fires_on: The period after the number 5 inside a parenthetical cross-reference such as "see Warnings and Precautions (5.1)". It fires on the dot before the subsection number.

modes.label: Warnings section reference
modes.description: The period between 5 and the subsection number in a bracketed Warnings and Precautions citation.

card.plain: It marks the dot in a section number like 5.1 when a label points the reader to the Warnings and Precautions section.
